class.name: OcgGpHypr
class.brief_description: Describes a branch of a hyperbola in 3D space. A hyperbola is defined by its major and minor radii and positioned in space with a coordinate system (a gp_Ax2 object) of which: - the origin is the center of the hyperbola, - the "X Direction" defines the major axis of the hyperbola, and - the "Y Direction" defines the minor axis of the hyperbola. The origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of this coordinate system together define the plane of the hyperbola. This coordinate system is the "local coordinate system" of the hyperbola. In this coordinate system, the equation of the hyperbola is: X*X/(MajorRadius**2)-Y*Y/(MinorRadius**2) = 1.0 The branch of the hyperbola described is the one located on the positive side of the major axis. The "main Direction" of the local coordinate system is a normal vector to the plane of the hyperbola. This vector gives an implicit orientation to the hyperbola. We refer to the "main Axis" of the local coordinate system as the "Axis" of the hyperbola. The following schema shows the plane of the hyperbola, and in it, the respective positions of the three branches of hyperbolas constructed with the functions OtherBranch, ConjugateBranch1, and ConjugateBranch2: Warning The major radius can be less than the minor radius. See Also gce_MakeHypr which provides functions for more complex hyperbola constructions Geom_Hyperbola which provides additional functions for constructing hyperbolas and works, in particular, with the parametric equations of hyperbolas

The origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of this ! coordinate system together define the plane of the ! hyperbola. This coordinate system is the "local ! coordinate system" of the hyperbola. In this coordinate ! system, the equation of the hyperbola is: ! X*X/(MajorRadius**2)-Y*Y/(MinorRadius**2) = 1.0 ! The branch of the hyperbola described is the one located ! on the positive side of the major axis. ! The "main Direction" of the local coordinate system is a ! normal vector to the plane of the hyperbola. This vector ! gives an implicit orientation to the hyperbola. We refer to ! the "main Axis" of the local coordinate system as the ! "Axis" of the hyperbola. ! The following schema shows the plane of the hyperbola, ! and in it, the respective positions of the three branches of ! hyperbolas constructed with the functions OtherBranch, ! ConjugateBranch1, and ConjugateBranch2: ! @code ! ^YAxis ! | ! FirstConjugateBranch ! | ! Other | Main ! --------------------- C ------------------------------>XAxis ! Branch | Branch ! | ! | ! SecondConjugateBranch ! | ^YAxis ! @endcode ! Warning ! The major radius can be less than the minor radius. ! See Also ! gce_MakeHypr which provides functions for more ! complex hyperbola constructions ! Geom_Hyperbola which provides additional functions for ! constructing hyperbolas and works, in particular, with the ! parametric equations of hyperbolas

method.name: gp_Hypr
method.description: Creates of an indefinite hyperbola.

method.name: SetAxis
method.description: Modifies this hyperbola, by redefining its local coordinate system so that: - its origin and "main Direction" become those of the axis theA1 (the "X Direction" and "Y Direction" are then recomputed in the same way as for any gp_Ax2). Raises ConstructionError if the direction of theA1 is parallel to the direction of the "XAxis" of the hyperbola.

method.name: SetLocation
method.description: Modifies this hyperbola, by redefining its local coordinate system so that its origin becomes theP.

method.name: SetMajorRadius
method.description: Modifies the major radius of this hyperbola. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if theMajorRadius is negative.

method.name: SetMinorRadius
method.description: Modifies the minor radius of this hyperbola. Exceptions Standard_ConstructionError if theMinorRadius is negative.

method.name: SetPosition
method.description: Modifies this hyperbola, by redefining its local coordinate system so that it becomes A2.

method.name: Asymptote1
method.description: In the local coordinate system of the hyperbola the equation of the hyperbola is (X*X)/(A*A) - (Y*Y)/(B*B) = 1.0 and the equation of the first asymptote is Y = (B/A)*X where A is the major radius and B is the minor radius. Raises ConstructionError if MajorRadius = 0.0

method.name: Asymptote2
method.description: In the local coordinate system of the hyperbola the equation of the hyperbola is (X*X)/(A*A) - (Y*Y)/(B*B) = 1.0 and the equation of the first asymptote is Y = -(B/A)*X. where A is the major radius and B is the minor radius. Raises ConstructionError if MajorRadius = 0.0

method.name: Axis
method.description: Returns the axis passing through the center, and normal to the plane of this hyperbola.

method.name: ConjugateBranch1
method.description: Computes the branch of hyperbola which is on the positive side of the "YAxis" of <me>.

method.name: ConjugateBranch2
method.description: Computes the branch of hyperbola which is on the negative side of the "YAxis" of <me>.

method.name: Directrix1
method.description: This directrix is the line normal to the XAxis of the hyperbola in the local plane (Z = 0) at a distance d = MajorRadius / e from the center of the hyperbola, where e is the eccentricity of the hyperbola. This line is parallel to the "YAxis". The intersection point between the directrix1 and the "XAxis" is the "Location" point of the directrix1. This point is on the positive side of the "XAxis".

method.name: Directrix2
method.description: This line is obtained by the symmetrical transformation of "Directrix1" with respect to the "YAxis" of the hyperbola.

method.name: Focal
method.description: Computes the focal distance. It is the distance between the the two focus of the hyperbola.

method.name: Focus1
method.description: Returns the first focus of the hyperbola. This focus is on the positive side of the "XAxis" of the hyperbola.

method.name: Focus2
method.description: Returns the second focus of the hyperbola. This focus is on the negative side of the "XAxis" of the hyperbola.

method.name: Location
method.description: Returns the location point of the hyperbola. It is the intersection point between the "XAxis" and the "YAxis".

method.name: MajorRadius
method.description: Returns the major radius of the hyperbola. It is the radius on the "XAxis" of the hyperbola.

method.name: MinorRadius
method.description: Returns the minor radius of the hyperbola. It is the radius on the "YAxis" of the hyperbola.

method.name: OtherBranch
method.description: Returns the branch of hyperbola obtained by doing the symmetrical transformation of <me> with respect to the "YAxis" of <me>.

method.name: Position
method.description: Returns the coordinate system of the hyperbola.

method.name: XAxis
method.description: Computes an axis, whose - the origin is the center of this hyperbola, and - the unit vector is the "X Direction" of the local coordinate system of this hyperbola. These axes are, the major axis (the "X Axis") and of this hyperboReturns the "XAxis" of the hyperbola.

method.name: YAxis
method.description: Computes an axis, whose - the origin is the center of this hyperbola, and - the unit vector is the "Y Direction" of the local coordinate system of this hyperbola. These axes are the minor axis (the "Y Axis") of this hyperbola

method.name: Mirrored_1
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of an hyperbola with respect to the point theP which is the center of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_2
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of an hyperbola with respect to an axis placement which is the axis of the symmetry.

method.name: Mirrored_3
method.description: Performs the symmetrical transformation of an hyperbola with respect to a plane. The axis placement theA2 locates the plane of the symmetry (Location, XDirection, YDirection).

method.name: Rotated
method.description: Rotates an hyperbola. theA1 is the axis of the rotation. theAng is the angular value of the rotation in radians.

method.name: Scaled
method.description: Scales an hyperbola. theS is the scaling value.

method.name: Transformed
method.description: Transforms an hyperbola with the transformation theT from class Trsf.

method.name: Translated_1
method.description: Translates an hyperbola in the direction of the vector theV. The magnitude of the translation is the vector's magnitude.

method.name: Translated_2
method.description: Translates an hyperbola from the point theP1 to the point theP2.
